snippet.title: USAAF Mustang Longplay (Arcade) [QHD]
snippet.description:
Game Info
---------------------------------------------------
Developer: UPL
Publisher: UPL
Year of Release: 1990

Game Review & Impressions
---------------------------------------------------
A shoot 'em up that starts out well enough, but the difficulty curve spikes well beyond anything approaching playable a few levels in.

Although it's visually attractive, the relatively realistic depictions of World War II battlefields and general thematics left me feeling a little conflicted; it didn't feel appropriate to turn the subject matter into a coin-op arcade game.
